purpose: Quantify implicit extra cash reserve created when score-proportional raw weight exceeds the 35% per-name cap and clipped weight is not redistributed.

thresholds.oneSelected: raw ratio equals 35%; cap does not create extra reserve
thresholds.twoSelected: cap binds when one name holds >58.333333% of total selected score weight
thresholds.threeOrMoreSelected: cap binds when one name holds >41.176471% of total selected score weight

accounting: nominal deployment target from selected-count rule
cap-induced reserve from clipped raw ratios
guardrails: cap-induced reserve may be intentional risk control; not labeled a bug
historical non-binding does not establish future non-binding
economic effect requires future outcome and opportunity-cost evidence
